requiredGates: Scoped authority for SQL v36, coordinator/container, Caddy route and frontend publication
Recoverable database/configuration backup and real PostgreSQL transactional rollback smoke
Immutable official Node 24 image digest and persistent protected Ed25519 signing key
Actual guest/registered identity, presence, leave, CAS and rematch canaries
Published client pinned to the real production public key, not a fixture key

limitations: Legacy SHA-only records cannot retroactively acquire independent-source signatures
Signed server timestamps are not independent external evidence of precommit publication time
Threshold-beacon, operator infrastructure and delivered-client trust remain explicit assumptions
No absolute physical-randomness or operator-intention claim is made
SQL mocks/static tests do not certify actual PostgreSQL execution
Healthy-source 6-9 second planned wait follows protocol arithmetic, not production measurement
Historical-key rotation needs a separate compatible trust catalogue before any key change
